notes: Reproduces the banked MedDeID Google-DLP comparison (google-dlp/run.py INFOTYPE_MAP, 2026-10-01). This table makes the schema gap explicit: Google's single PERSON_NAME cannot express PATIENT NAME, PROVIDER NAME, or NAME separately (177 gold spans unmatchable), and it has no AGE, OCCUPATION, or FACILITY detectors (87 spans uncatchable). Those 264 spans are not a detection failure; they are a schema-compatibility result. Local predictions use identity mapping. Character recall is label-agnostic and reported alongside as the schema-independent number.
